item.description: - **CFTC rules published October 19 split prediction market event contracts from sportsbook and casino gambling, Casino Journal reports** — Casino Journal reported the CFTC published two documents in the Federal Register on October 19 setting out where federal derivatives law ends and state gambling law begins.
